response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM media_type_stats), filtered_types AS (SELECT mts.* FROM media_type_stats mts WHERE mts.rate > (SELECT avg_rate FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(rate) as average_rate, AVG(track_count) as average_number_of_tracks, AVG(rate) - (SELECT avg_rate FROM overall_avg) as average_margin FROM filtered_types
